story:
Diamond Ridge Industrial Services is a women-owned industrial services company based in the Mid-Atlantic region, delivering advanced concrete and surface protection solutions for facilities that cannot afford failure.

Traditional concrete repair methods were not built for today's industrial demands. Rigid, cement-based fixes are expensive, disruptive, and prone to cracking — often leading to repeated repairs, extended downtime, and rising maintenance costs. We built the company around a different approach: preventative maintenance strategies that reduce disruption, extend surface life, and protect the long-term investment in the slab.

Our flagship service, Fibrecrete-G, is the foundation of what sets us apart. Engineered to outperform traditional concrete, it combines flexibility and strength to handle heavy traffic, structural movement and extreme temperature changes without cracking or separating the way rigid repairs do. It cures in an hour or less, installs at low temperatures, and meets ASTM requirements — which means a repair can go in during a night shift in January and carry forklifts before the morning pick wave.

Around that flagship sit four more services covering the rest of what a floor needs: concrete joint repair and protection, industrial floor coatings, traditional concrete repair for the cases where rigid load-bearing restoration genuinely is the right answer, and certified floor line marking. Freezer and cold storage floors are a specialism rather than an exception.

Our team brings hands-on experience, technical knowledge, and disciplined execution to every project. We understand the demands of warehouses, manufacturing facilities, logistics centers and commercial operations, and we deliver solutions designed to perform under real-world conditions across Pennsylvania, New York, New Jersey, Delaware, Maryland and West Virginia.
